field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this peer in the selected server configuration. Disabled peers are omitted from the live server instance after Apply.

field.label: Name
field.help: Descriptive client name used in the OPNsense UI and generated client configuration filename.

field.label: Server
field.help: Select the AmneziaWG server this peer belongs to.

field.label: Allowed IPs
field.help: Client tunnel address/routes owned by this peer, normally e.g. 10.8.1.2/32

field.label: Client Public Key
field.help: AmneziaWG public key of this client. Use Generate Client Keys for a new client, or paste the public key of an existing client.

field.label: Pre-Shared Key
field.help: Optional symmetric pre-shared key. If configured, the exact same key must be present on the client.

field.label: Persistent Keepalive
field.help: Optional per-peer PersistentKeepalive. Accepts 0-65535 or an AWG 3.1 range such as 20-30. Usually blank on a server unless periodic traffic to this peer is explicitly required.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note for this peer. It is shown only in the OPNsense UI and is not sent over the tunnel.
